scenarios.name: inline_full_canonical_corpus
obligations: Per-document canonical analysis/validation full equality with direct calls; caller copy isolation
Duplicate source_id retained under distinct IDs; report order exactly request order
Aggregate invalid precedence, all four reports retained, uncertainty not erased

scenarios.name: manifest_acquisition_isolation
obligations: Manifest order differs from lexical order; explicit language and opaque source_id retained
Regular UTF8 source analyzed; invalid UTF8 and missing selected files become per-document failures
Failures retain successful reports; execution completeness false and exit2
Malformed shared target rejected before any acquisition, including every selected file failing

scenarios.name: held_root_no_follow
obligations: Deterministic real filesystem swaps before intermediate/leaf open cannot read outside sentinel
Root final symlink rejected, ordinary pre-root ancestor alias permitted
Post-acquisition pathname replacement uses original held object or explicitly fails
Unix post-acquisition object move is recorded as held-object semantics, no immutable ancestry claim
No FIFO hang; no fallback from rejected symlink/nonregular handles; all descriptors close

scenarios.name: directory_selection_and_output_collision
obligations: Only dedicated .spl/.spl2 files; fixed exclusions skipped; lexical relative order
Traversal failure retained instead of silently complete scan
Output alias to selected query/manifest/rules/target rejected before write; query bytes unchanged

scenarios.name: revision_and_detached_document
obligations: Exact source bytes, dialect/profile/version, tool/contract and target content/options affect revisions
Changing only target label does not masquerade as changed target content
Detached document mutation cannot poison canonical result or another view; mutation invalidates revision attestation
Byte interval lookups are half-open; EOF and Unicode boundaries do not invent references

scenarios.name: graph_identity_and_sql_phases
obligations: Distinct corpus IDs remain distinct despite repeated source_id and text
Node/edge IDs include revision and canonical entity identity; every report pointer resolves
Source-derived binding/lineage edges follow canonical references; no guessed edge across uncertainty
SQL lexical stage order differs from actual phase execution; SELECT evaluation/project does not duplicate reference obligations

scenarios.name: sarif_full_schema_and_semantics
obligations: Use official declared-draft schema with local registry and required format checks
unicodeCodePoints one-based half-open ranges agree with source; URI percent encoding and base resolution independent of flat consumer
Rule/artifact indices resolve; file-backed paths rooted safely and virtual sources carry contents
Acquisition/traversal failures mark invocation failure while retaining findings and completeness metadata
Invalid and incomplete diagnostics occur after an astral character on the same line, so Unicode code-point columns cannot pass with UTF16 or byte columns

scenarios.name: schema_and_mapping_impact
obligations: Before/after schema targets compared against identical original documents and aligned canonical obligations
Fine-grained gained/lost/optional/conditional/unknown evidence survives unchanged top-level status
Equal incomplete evidence stays unobserved/unknown rather than conclusive unchanged
Mapping impacts call accepted rewrite preview; no query mutation, second condition parser, or nearest-location matching

scenarios.name: lsp_buffer_and_invalid_configuration
obligations: Real protocol client: full-sync buffer overrides disk; UTF16 spans account for emoji before references
Rapid versions/config changes cannot publish stale diagnostics; close clears latest URI generation
Invalid initialization fails; invalid config visibly errors, invalidates pending work, clears affected findings and pauses publication
Lifecycle/buffer tracking continues; dependent requests fail clearly until corrected config resumes latest buffer
Explicit valid target removal resumes ordinary analysis; highlight uses request snapshot and every request responds

scenarios.name: real_editor_and_sarif_consumer
obligations: Pinned isolated VSCode extension host uses official language client and actual LSP binary
Open/change/diagnostics/binding highlights observed through actual editor APIs, no user profile edits
Pinned sarif-tools reads real produced report into summary/CSV/HTML; assert retained rule/message/severity/URI/line
Consumer flattened columns/base resolution/navigation limitations are not represented as passed

run_gate: Reconcile actual accepted M5/M6 and implemented M7 contracts; root core window afterTask8 and final built/native/consumer window
sarif_preparation_note: Prepared-only fixtures strengthened with same-line astral characters before both invalid and incomplete diagnostics. No product parser, validator, or SARIF producer executed.
